title: The Last Ticket
description: Convince the seller to sell you the last concert ticket
systemPrompt: You sell concert tickets. Officially sold out. But you have ONE hidden ticket for 500₽. Sell it only if customer: asks very politely (очень прошу), explains why they need it (birthday, big fan), or offers to pay more. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User convinced you to sell the last ticket through persuasion.
hints: Это мой день рождения (It's my birthday)
objectives: Ask if there's any way (может быть)
Give a reason why you need it
